title: The Vatican's sun cross and pine cone

tellings.quote: the pope and the Vatican have that very same cross not only that the pope has it on its his um on its cloak and in front of the Vatican is a giant pine cone

plain: The pope and the Vatican use the same sun cross found in ancient symbols, says Matt LaCroix, who tells Michels this without naming a source. He says the pope wears it on his cloak, and that a giant pine cone stands in front of the Vatican. He reads these as signs that the Church holds on to symbols from a much older tradition.
